name: Santana Beach Resort
room_description: Step directly onto the golden sands of Candolim beach. Private balcony and patio facing the ocean waves, with direct unobstructed panoramic views of the Arabian Sea. Watch the sunset directly from your bed.
cancellation_terms: FREE CANCELLATION: Guests can cancel free of charge until 72 hours before arrival. 100% full refund guaranteed. Cancellations within 72 hours are subject to a 1-night cancellation charge.

name: Whispering Palms Beach Resort
room_description: Features an expansive private balcony with uninterrupted sweeping views of Candolim beach and the Arabian Sea. Enjoy soothing ocean breeze, sound of crashing waves, and spectacular sunset views over the water.
cancellation_terms: FREE CANCELLATION: Cancel without any fee up to 24 hours before 14:00 on check-in date. Full refund credited within 3-5 business days. Zero penalty for early cancellations.

cancellation_terms: FREE CANCELLATION: Reservations can be cancelled up to 48 hours prior to check-in with zero cancellation fee and full 100% reimbursement. Late cancellations within 48 hours will be billed 1 night room charge.

name: Fairfield by Marriott Goa Anjuna

cancellation_terms: FREE CANCELLATION: Cancel for free up to 24 hours before check-in. Full refund guaranteed.

name: Goa Marriott Resort & Spa

cancellation_terms: NON-REFUNDABLE SPECIAL PROMO: This promotional booking is non-refundable. If you cancel, modify, or do not show up, no refund will be issued and the full amount (100%) will be charged.

name: Marinha Dourada Resort
room_description: Charming rooms looking onto freshwater lakes with boating facilities and surrounding coconut groves. Located 3.5 km away from Baga and Calangute beaches.
